gloss: to look down; to hang one's head

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: うつむきませんでした

forms.negative: うつむいていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: うつむいていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to look down; to hang one's head; to bow one's head
definitions.explanation: To tilt one's face or head downward. Often associated with emotions such as sadness, shame, or deep thought.

examples.japanese: ⟦{恥|は}ずかしくて→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧うつむいて⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I was so embarrassed that I looked down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧うつむいた⟦まま→まま：02007_mama⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{言|い}わなかった→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: He remained looking down and said nothing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悲|かな}しそう→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧うつむく⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忘|わす}れられない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I can't forget the sight of her hanging her head sadly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{叱|しか}られて→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧うつむいた。
examples.english: Scolded by the teacher, the children looked down.

examples.japanese: うつむいて⟦{歩|ある}いていた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ら、⟦{電柱|でんちゅう}→電柱：17913_denchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぶつかり→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I was walking with my head down and almost bumped into a utility pole.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). Can also be written as {俯|うつむ}く with kanji.

USAGE:
うつむく often conveys emotional nuance - people look down when embarrassed, sad, ashamed, or deep in thought. It's different from simply looking at the ground; it implies an emotional or psychological state.

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
・うつむきがち - tending to look down
・うつむき⟦{加減|かげん}→加減：02602_kagen⟧ - with head slightly bowed
・うつむいて⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ - to walk with head down

CONTRAST:
・⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}く→向く：02304_muku⟧ - to look up (antonym)
・⟦うなだれる→うなだれる：07835_unadareru⟧ - to hang one's head (more pronounced drooping, often from exhaustion or defeat)

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in both spoken and written Japanese.
